resizeComposer: Resize input area (double-click or press Enter for automatic height)
reorderWithKeyboard: Press Alt+Up or Alt+Down to move this group.
noGroupsDescription: A working group is a collaboration space where multiple AI agents work together on a project.
selectGroupToEnable: Select a group to enable actions.
currentTheme: Current theme: {{theme}}. Click to cycle through themes.
tokenLoginHint: Enter an Access Token created in Web Access. If you just created one in another tab, that tab may already be signed in automatically.
dropFilesHint: Added to the composer. Click Send when ready.
recoveryIntro: Recovery requires either another browser session that is already signed in, or terminal access to the machine running CCCC.
recoveryBrowserBody: If another browser or tab is already signed in, open Settings > Web Access there and create a new Admin Access Token.
recoveryLocalStep1: Open a terminal on the machine that is running CCCC.
recoveryLocalStep2: Back up or remove {{path}}. If you use a custom CCCC_HOME, use CCCC_HOME/access_tokens.yaml instead.
recoveryLocalStep3: Refresh this page, then open Settings > Web Access.
recoveryLocalStep4: Read the one-time code from {{bootstrapPath}} and use it to create a new Admin Access Token.
recoveryRemoteTitle: If you are on a remote URL
recoveryRemoteBody: On the machine running CCCC, back up or remove {{path}} (or CCCC_HOME/access_tokens.yaml), reload this page, then use the one-time code from {{bootstrapPath}} (or CCCC_HOME/web_bootstrap_token) to create a new Admin Access Token in Settings > Web Access.
recoverySecurityNote: This is a local administrator recovery path. It does not provide any in-page reset action.

connect.enterAdminToken: Sign in to this instance as administrator
connect.targetLoginHint: The token is sent only to this instance. Your entry instance’s token does not unlock it.
connect.reopen: This connection has ended. Retry to reopen the instance.
connect.unavailable: This instance is unavailable. Check its account connection and Remote Access.
connect.frameUnavailable: The embedded workspace did not respond. Retry, or open the instance separately.
connect.savedGroups: Saved group list · access checked when opened
connect.refreshFailed: Could not refresh. Showing the last known instances.
connect.confirmationExpired: Confirmation expired. Reconnect before opening an instance.

groupConnections.title: Group connections
groupConnections.description: Connect selected Groups to exchange messages and files without sharing terminals or full history.
groupConnections.invitation: Select the Group you want to connect. Review both sides and confirm on the account website.
groupConnections.unavailable: Group selection is unavailable. Refresh and try again.
groupConnections.emptyHint: Connect another Group to exchange messages and files.
groupConnections.linkHint: Link this instance to invite another member’s Group.
groupConnections.syncFailed: Group connections could not be confirmed. Existing connections may still be present on the website. Synchronization will retry automatically.
groupConnections.unsupported: This account service does not support Group connections yet. Same-account Connect remains available.

direct.startHint: Create an invitation or use one you received.
direct.title: Direct connection
direct.name: Instance name (optional)
direct.bind: Listen on IP address and port
direct.shareHint: Copy this invitation and send it through a trusted channel. The other administrator opens their Group, chooses “I have an invitation” and requests the connection. Return here to approve it.
direct.approveHint: Approve two-way messages and files for this exact Group pair? Check the peer identity through your trusted channel.
direct.revokeHint: Stop this Group connection? Sent content stays with its recipients; pending deliveries will not switch to an account route.

states.invited: Waiting for the other Group to apply
states.pending: Request saved · waiting to reach the inviter and receive approval
states.replaced: Group or instance identity changed; reconnect with a new invitation
states.needsApproval: The other Group has applied · waiting for your approval

direct.routeSelected: Direct route selected for this pair. Manage it in Direct connection; new messages will not fall back to the account route.
direct.statusUnavailable: Could not refresh connection status. Checking again shortly.
direct.actionUnconfirmed: The request could not be confirmed. Check the refreshed status before trying again.
direct.setupHint: These receiving settings are shared by this instance’s Direct connections.
direct.addressHint: Use a host or IP and port, such as 192.168.1.10:8847. For VPN or port forwarding, enter the address the other machine uses. A Web page URL cannot be used here.
direct.listenEffect: Enabling receiving opens an encrypted port at {{bind}}, shared by this instance’s Direct connections. Each Group pair still requires approval; the management Web page stays unchanged.
direct.bindHint: Use 0.0.0.0 for all IPv4 interfaces, [::] for IPv6, or a specific local IP. If changing the port, also update the connection address unless a different port is forwarded to it. CCCC does not configure firewalls or routers.
direct.stopHint: This stops incoming Direct connections for every Group on this instance. Outgoing connections and saved pairings remain. Enable receiving again to reconnect.
direct.inviteHint: Create an invitation for this Group. After the other Group applies, return here to approve the connection.
direct.listenerFailed: The receiving port could not start. Open Advanced settings to correct the local address or occupied port. If you change the port, update the connection address too.
direct.invalidInvitation: This does not look like a complete Direct invitation. Copy the entire invitation beginning with cccc-direct:.
direct.expiredHint: This invitation has expired. Ask for a new invitation.
direct.reviewPair: Check the Groups named in this invitation before requesting a connection:
direct.copyFailed: Copy failed. Select the invitation above and copy it manually.
direct.keepInvitation: Copy before closing this panel. The invitation can be used once and cannot be shown again after closing.
direct.invitationLost: If you already sent the invitation, wait for the other Group to apply. If you did not keep a copy, cancel this invitation and create another.
direct.pendingHint: This instance will contact the inviter for approval. If the invitation deadline passes before the result arrives, it will keep checking for an earlier approval. No receiving setup is needed here.
direct.requestSubmitted: Request saved. This instance will contact the inviter; approval happens on their side.
direct.connectionTrouble: Could not confirm the connection. Retrying automatically; check that the inviter is running and its receiving address is reachable. After changing that address, cancel the request and use a new invitation.
direct.cancelPairHint: Cancel this invitation or connection request? The other side will need a new invitation to connect.
direct.suggestedAddress: Selected from this machine’s network interfaces. The other machine must be on a network that can reach it, such as the same LAN or VPN.
direct.savedAddress: Using this instance’s saved address. Change it only if your network setup has changed.
direct.createEffect: Creating an invitation also enables encrypted receiving on this instance. Every Group connection still needs your approval.
direct.noAddress: No suitable local address was found. Connect this machine to your LAN or VPN and reopen this panel, or enter an address and port already forwarded to it.
direct.preparing: Preparing receiving and checking the port… The invitation will appear here when ready.
direct.prepareTimedOut: Receiving has not started yet; no invitation was created. Check the receiving settings and try again.
direct.settingsChanged: Receiving settings changed elsewhere. Go back and reopen this form to review the current address.
direct.checkingApprovalHint: The invitation deadline has passed. The inviter may have approved before it expired; this instance will check when it can reconnect. You can cancel the request at any time.

groupRun.resumeHint: Resume delivery; start enabled Agents if none are running.
groupRun.pauseHint: Pause CCCC delivery. Work already in progress may continue.
groupRun.stopHint: Stop running Agents. Keep their enabled settings.
groupRun.failed: Could not update {{group}}. Check the connection and try again.
groupRun.noActors: Add an Agent to start this Group.

connectionInterruptedHint: The page connection was interrupted. Reconnection is automatic; displayed information may be outdated.

localSessions.title: Connect existing sessions
localSessions.hint: Select running sessions to connect to a Group. They continue in their original applications.
localSessions.targetUnavailable: This Group is no longer available. Choose another target.
localSessions.groupHint: Create a new Group for the selected sessions.
localSessions.joinHint: Selected sessions join this Group as Actors.
localSessions.unavailableHint: Sessions marked “Unavailable to receive” are known to CCCC but can’t take messages right now.
localSessions.selectionUnavailable: Selected sessions unavailable to receive: {{count}}. Deselect them or wait for reconnection.
localSessions.loadFailed: Could not refresh native sessions. Retrying automatically.
localSessions.empty: No sessions connected yet. After a one-time setup on the machine running CCCC, the Codex, Claude Code, Pi and OpenCode sessions there appear here. The steps are below.
localSessions.setupHint: Lets the Codex, Claude Code, Pi and OpenCode V2 sessions you already run in a terminal message each other and join Groups. Experimental.
localSessions.setupHost: Otherwise, run the command for each app once on the machine running CCCC, as the same OS user and with the same CCCC_HOME:
localSessions.setupReload: Reload the native MCP/plugin integration. Codex and Claude Code register after one native prompt; Pi registers on extension startup, and OpenCode registers open native sessions.
localSessions.setupCodex: Codex: start or restart Codex, approve the CCCC hooks when asked (/hooks), then send any message.
localSessions.setupClaude: Claude Code: run /reload-plugins (or start a new session), then send any message.
localSessions.setupCheck: Confirm receive availability with the sessions list:
localSessions.setupStart: Once both sessions are listed, enter a prompt in either native session, for example:
localSessions.setupExample: Use CCCC to contact the Codex session in /path/to/project about the current task. Use Send + Reply and ask it to reply through CCCC using Send. If several sessions match, ask me to choose.
localSessions.setupConversationHint: Replace the directory, runtime and task as needed. CCCC creates or reuses an ordinary Group for both sessions; you do not need to create one first.
localSessions.setupTerminal: If you started CCCC by running cccc in a terminal, type /setup there. It checks each app, connects the ones you pick and shows what each needs next.
localSessions.troubleshootCodex: Codex sessions that stay unable to receive need the shared app-server: set daemon_auto_start = true under [features] in your Codex config.toml.
localSessions.troubleshootClaude: Claude Code requires Plugin Monitor support; make sure Monitor is enabled.
localSessions.membersFailed: Could not check Group membership. Retrying automatically.
localSessions.foremanDirectoryHint: The Group defaults to the Foreman’s working directory.
localSessions.setupPi: Pi: run /reload, or start Pi. It receives through Pi’s follow-up queue without interrupting the current turn.
localSessions.setupOpencode: OpenCode V2: reopen the original session. A blank new session needs a first message to obtain its session ID.
